descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S08 「BAA 表：每个在用的 provider 加 Topflight-Venkata，按「已签」「覆盖这项服务」「覆盖这个账号」」 BAA table: every active provider plus Topflight-Venkata, by signed, covers this service, covers this account

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Every AI provider in active use has a signed, coverage-confirmed BAA: confirmed and coverage-verified for that provider's service and for the account that is actually used, not assumed from the provi …（UAT OAT-05；TFA-94059 AC 1；TFA-94059 AC 2；TFA-92568 AC 8；TFA-92568 Product 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress
  • U3c OpenAI BAA coverage is confirmed for GPT-live specifically, for the org and endpoint production uses, before any real patient dictation.（TFA-94423 AC 2；UAT OAT-05 step 3）
  • U5 Topflight's BAA with Venkata Technologies is signed, so Topflight's own BAA obligation is resolved.（UAT OAT-05；TFA-94059 AC 3；TFA-92568 AC 10；TFA-92568 Product 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given The S07 report, the BAA documents held by Daniela and Vikram, and the Topflight-Venkata Technologies BAA (owner Bajer)

When Fill one row per active provider and service (Bedrock Haiku, Bedrock Mistral, OpenAI realtime gpt-live-transcribe at /v1/realtime/calls, OpenAI whisper-1 at /v1/audio/transcriptions, OpenAI text if selectable, Vertex Gemini, Convex, plus Deepgram and SES per Q3), and one row for Topflight-Venkata Technologies. …

Then Every row has a yes in every column, with a dated document behind each yes. The OpenAI row for the endpoint production uses is covered for GPT-live specifically. The Topflight-Venkata BAA is signed by both parties, dated, and its scope covers Topflight's work on Round Companion.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-05 step 2 and Expected 'coverage-verified for every active provider, not just assumed from a provider having a BAA in general'; TFA-94059 AC 1 and AC 2; TFA-92568 AC 8; TFA-94423 AC 2. A 'no' or 'unknown' in any cell of an active row is a Fail, quoted with the row. A general BAA with no service or account match is a Fail. …

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 DOC · 文档核对；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S08 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-05.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：DOC · 文档核对；辅助：CONFIG · 配置核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：code-review。
